title: UPPSC Pre Online Form 2026 (500 Posts)
postName: Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services (PCS) Examination 2026 – Advt A-1/E-1/2026
vacancyDetails: About 500 posts including Deputy Collector, DSP, BDO, ARTO, Naib Tehsildar and other upper subordinate services
qualification: Bachelor Degree in any stream from a recognized University
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on crucial date (relaxations as per UPPSC rules)
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppsc.up.nic.in
2. Open Advt A-1/E-1/2026 PCS Apply Online
3. Register / login and fill form
4. Pay fee via SBI MOPS
5. Submit by 27 July 2026; correction till 3 Aug 2026
shortDescription: UPPSC PCS Pre Online Form 2026 for ~500 posts. Apply 25 June – 27 July 2026 at uppsc.up.nic.in.
content:
UPPSC has released Combined State / Upper Subordinate Services (PCS) Examination 2026 for about 500 posts (Advt. A-1/E-1/2026).

Apply online: 25 June 2026 to 27 July 2026. Fee payment last date 27 July 2026. Correction window till about 3 August 2026.

Selection: Prelims, Mains and Interview. Official site: uppsc.up.nic.in.
